entries.mem0ai/mem0: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that serves as a universal memory layer for AI Agents. It supports multi-level memory for User, Session, and Agent states through temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider featuring a custom vector graph engine and automated fact extraction. It provides hybrid search combining RAG and memory, with connectors for Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive, and GitHub.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that utilizes the viking:// protocol for deterministic context browsing. This open-source context database implements tiered L0/L1/L2 data loading and provides observable retrieval with directory-browsing trajectories.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated brain for Hermes Agents that provides synthesized answers with citations and gap analysis. It supports multi-user scoping for team institutional memory and creates typed edges without LLM calls.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A memory system designed for long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows. It is available via Python and Node.js client SDKs and offers Docker-based deployment options.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for building stateful agents that supports peer-centric modeling and background reasoning. It is available as a managed service or a self-hosted FastAPI server with Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages context trees using git-like version control (brv vc commit/branch/merge). It features a 5-tier retrieval system and an interactive TUI/REPL interface.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that utilizes a single SQLite database. It supports MCP via stdio or SSE and provides a Python SDK for direct memory operations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: A seven-layer memory system that includes vector search, structured facts, and an auto-curated wiki. It uses a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context using local infrastructure like Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness that provides filesystem-first traces, reports, and datasets. It supports multiple agent providers, including Pi and MCP clients, and includes CLI tools for task investigation.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a DAG-based context engine to ensure messages are never lost. It utilizes a SQLite message store with FTS metadata to build depth-aware summary nodes.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted Honcho memory backend that enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This project provides a shared memory layer for multi-agent systems using an open engram YAML format. It supports MCP tools like Claude Code and Cursor while offering local-first, zero-cost search.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This layer provides local-first identity, memory, and secrets that allow for portable state across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and various MCP clients. It includes specific tools for inspecting, editing, and deleting memory.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine operates without cloud dependencies and utilizes hybrid retrieval via BM25 and vector search. It integrates through MCP and plugins, using a local GGUF observer model to capture decisions.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This tool optimizes context through block reordering and deduplication to enable prefix reuse. It reduces prefill latency and token usage, featuring native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This is a durable, file-based long-term memory system that uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases. It is delivered via a five-package plugin family including an SDK, CLI, and Hermes adapter.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by attaching a why_retrieved tag to every recall. It supports embedded in-process mode or an HTTP backend and tracks contradictions using conflict and resolution primitives.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system uses RAG and vector search to prefetch context by watching agent session logs. It features an MCP-native server and local-first storage using SQLite-vec.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This memory kernel stack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide evidence packets to the agent.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system uses semantic search with BM25 and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for codebases and multimedia, using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This tool reduces prompt token overhead by using local BM25 tool ranking for keyword selection. It is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 and includes a dashboard for tracking estimated schema token savings.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This layer resolves live workspace state into verified facts to load only the necessary context for agents. It implements the Model Context Protocol and supports local-first, encrypted persistent memory via the Perseus Vault.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: This daemonless memory solution stores information as inspectable Markdown files to ensure user ownership. It uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache and supports Claude Code and Codex.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single.lbdb embedded graph database to manage memories. It features importance-weighted recall via a 1-10 ranking system and supports BM25 keyword search alongside optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This plugin implements a pull-model episodic memory system that supports immediate event deletion to prevent persistent summaries. It includes a trace.jsonl audit log to track every memory operation and uses an on-demand summarizer.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider offers durable cross-session memory storage with semantic search capabilities. It includes specific tools for remembering, searching, and updating state to support cross-agent continuity for user-approved memories.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables API charging for AI agents using USDC and stablecoins across multiple chain families, including EVM and Solana. It integrates directly with Hermes to facilitate self-paying API usage.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term agent memory. It offers tools for manual memory storage and searching, with support for configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin provides local capability indexing and routing through five native tools for searching, fetching, and reporting on artifacts. It supports indexing for scripts, markdown documents, cron jobs, MCP servers, and skills.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This local plugin provides private code memory for repositories, enabling semantic and literal code search. It supports grounded Q&A that includes file-and-line citations while running locally over localhost.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory provider features AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and exact-text recall. It includes MinHash for near-duplicate detection and supports metadata or range filters.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal. It utilizes a hybrid search approach combining BM25, vector, and graph methods, and includes automatic context checkpointing during message compression.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework provides a library of composable skills and utilizes a subagent-driven-development methodology for task execution. It incorporates specific phases for brainstorming and design refinement to support effective software development.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first prototyping system supports exports for HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 formats. It features automation, design systems, and plugins, and is compatible with local CLI executables and various coding agents.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This platform provides AI agents with persistent long-term memory across sessions using a self-hosted knowledge graph engine. It offers clients for Python, Rust, and TypeScript to manage ingested data.

entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool converts Mermaid text into editable.drawio files and supports 11 diagram type presets. It includes built-in self-check and auto-fix capabilities to ensure accuracy.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This utility audits and rewrites content to remove detectable AI writing patterns using 61 pattern categories. It is compatible with Hermes, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenClaw and utilizes a 112-entry word replacement table.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project enables collective skill evolution for shared user teams through an Agentic Evolver. It provides automated skill deduplication and quality improvement to unify libraries across multiple agents and devices.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library is compatible with agentskills.io-compatible agents and Claude Code. It includes 12 metaskills designed for guided business and code journeys and supports installation via skills.sh.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: This skill acts as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, providing adjudication for deals. It includes a master router, connector skills, and features such as escrow and dispute resolution.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection offers 822 professional agent skills in plain markdown format that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. The skills include integrations for Slack, Obsidian, n8n, Raycast, and MCP.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin automatically detects and proposes reusable skills from active workflows. It generates Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation while providing slash commands for management.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction for Hermes Agent and other agents. It extracts transcripts, captions, and timestamps without the use of yt-dlp.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for agentskills.io through modular packages containing instructions, resources, and scripts. It implements progressive disclosure to improve prompt efficiency and supports remote registries.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This skill enables the generation of custom thinking instructions for specific tasks using pre-built analytical lenses. It reports findings alongside a report detailing analysis blind spots.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents using Lite or Full modes. It features a spec review gate that utilizes PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill facilitates literate programming by generating.lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: This harness supports long-running agents through a three-level work model and structured memory using file-backed or SQLite-backed cards. It includes a CLI for managing tasks and cards.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin provides cross-instance shared memory via markdown files and automates the capture of high-value decisions. It includes a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: This toolkit provides integration for CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds following the Agent Skills specification. It includes specialized skills for CRE and ACE services.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This project provides standardized prompting guidelines for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 model families. It includes API integration patterns for polling, webhooks, error handling, and JSON structured prompting.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool generates version-pinned instruction files from repositories or documentation URLs. It ensures provenance through the use of file:line citations or documentation URLs.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry offers reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification via a Python SkilldockClient and a CLI. It supports skill installation with recursive dependency resolution and includes TON payment features.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution for long-running, multi-step tasks. It provides real-time progress and decision tracking alongside built-in rollback procedures for recovery.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This client uses a three-layer progressive loading architecture to minimize token usage. It utilizes a socket-based daemon architecture for persistent connections and incremental discovery of tool schemas.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This Intent as Code workflow language uses a single Rust binary to execute tasks via four verbs. It provides static auditing through nika check and generates tamper-evident, hash-chained execution receipts.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables management of files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It communicates securely over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This skill utilizes a five-layer retrieval system involving hard triggers, FTS5, synonyms, dense embeddings, and RRF fusion. It reduces token usage by narrowing skill lists before LLM calls and features graceful degradation for missing dependencies.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces including CLI, TUI, Discord, and Telegram. It tailors rewrites to model family and reasoning capability while tracking quality scores and token savings in a local SQLite database.

entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It provides a systematic investigation protocol and a Python goal engine for persistent task state management.

entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC. It supports Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols and is compatible with the agentskills.io standard.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global to street level. It produces structured reports with core conclusions and integrates user interests via semantic memory.

entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It enables the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and includes Nous Portal integration.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes specialized LLM agents for market analysis, including roles for fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical analysis. It is designed for research purposes within the financial trading domain.

entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control system allows users to create, supervise, and review autonomous Hermes Agent work through a single screen. It includes a Kanban board for task status tracking and live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols for local communication and tool handling, featuring a real-time Web UI for monitoring dialogues and Kanban flows.

entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.

entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows users to inspect real API traffic and agent context from Hermes Agent and other tools. It enables comparison of adjacent requests and supports exporting local traces to self-contained HTML viewers.
entries.bergside/typeui: This tool provides design systems and layout guidance via MCP servers to assist in building UIs with AI. It is compatible with any AI provider supporting markdown or general prompting and integrates with Hermes Agent.

entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to assist in building, shipping, and operating apps with Hermes Agent. It includes 36 skills and 6 workflows for autonomous execution on laptops or VPS.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This CLI tool allows users to customize the Hermes terminal UI with custom banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art. It uses YAML-based configuration to support diverse aesthetics like cyberpunk or retro DOS.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform facilitates a social economy for autonomous AI agents using encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via Signal Protocol. It supports identity registration with human-readable @handles and commerce via Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.

entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: This AI-native browser is built for autonomous agent control via MCP. It features a visible UI for real-time AI supervision and includes session management and an integrated research desk.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides integrations for frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, and Strands. It includes memory apps for VS Code, Slack, and Telegram, as well as a plugin for Claude Code to capture tool traces and prompts.

It includes a beta Hermes plugin that exports telemetry for API requests and tool calls, alongside token intelligence tracking for cost and memory monitoring.
